ns2:course.label: Neurobio of Physical Activity
ns2:course.description: Course survey of the neural mechanisms underlying physical activity. Includes both basic science and consideration of the effects of disease and trauma conditions. Prerequisite: Graduate or Professional (DVM) students. Senior students in Kinesiology or Bioengineering. Or successful completion of MCB 103 or 402, NEUR 303, or consent of instructor.
